call_points.text: Management reiterated target to compound at 2x to 2.5x India's nominal GDP growth rate.
Cost-to-assets ratio excluding guarantee premium improved to 3.9% in Q2 from 4.0% in Q1.
Cost of funds declined 43 bps YoY and 7 bps QoQ to 6.41%.
Added 45 new deposit branches and 100+ asset centers in Q2, taking total touchpoints to 3,103.
Cost-to-assets (excl. guarantee premium) improved to 3.9% in Q2'FY27 from 4.0% in Q2'FY26.
ICRA upgraded outlook on long-term credit rating to Positive from Stable, retaining 'ICRA AA'.
Management expects the franchise to sustainably compound at 2 to 2.5x of India's nominal GDP growth rate.

guidance.statement: Management expects to compound at 2x to 2.5x India's nominal GDP growth rate over the next 10 years.
Cost to assets ratio is expected to improve on a full-year basis.
Scope for improvement in opex and credit cost versus full FY26 to reach the guided 1.8% ROA range.
MFI book capped at up to 10% of the portfolio.

operating_notes.text: The bank operates over 2,790 banking touchpoints across 21 States and 4 Union Territories, serving over 1.2 crore customers.
Gold loan book IRR is about 15.5%, average ticket size around ₹2.5 lakh, over 80% rural, majority of book below ₹5 lakh.
Technology expenditure is close to ₹1,000 Cr, around 12–13% of total opex.
Average cost of savings deposits is about 5.05% and term deposits around 7.25%; FCNR rates raised to about 7.4–7.5%.
RBI in-principle approval for Universal Bank transition received Aug 7, 2025; final application submitted March 2026.
Average LCR for Q2'FY27 was 116%, carrying additional liquidity equivalent to 10-15% of LCR in high-quality non-LCR investments.
Total touchpoints expanded to 3,103 across 21 States and 4 UTs as of 30th Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹5,019.15 Cr (+17.5% YoY), net profit ₹831.87 Cr (+65.2% YoY).
AU Small Finance Bank reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹832 Cr, up 65% YoY, with gross advances reaching ₹1,40,327 Cr.
AU Small Finance Bank Limited shared the audio recording of its April 27, 2026 conference call discussing audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
AU Small Finance Bank reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹832 Cr, up 65% YoY, and filed its final universal banking license application.

AU Small Finance Bank Limited’s promoters—Mr. Sanjay Agarwal, Ms. Jyoti Agarwal, Ms. Shakuntala Agarwal, Ms. Maltika Agarwal, Mr. Yuvraj Agarwal, and MYS Holdings Private Limited—declared no new encumbrances on equity shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
AU Small Finance Bank announced that the RBI approved Kotak Mahindra Bank to acquire up to a 9.99% stake in the bank.
AU Small Finance Bank adopted Intellect Design Arena's Purple Fabric platform and PF Credit agents to accelerate its AI-first banking journey.

On 25 July 2026 AU Small Finance Bank's Q1FY27 call reported PAT up 37% YoY to ₹796 Cr, NIM at 5.9% and deposits up 24% YoY to ₹1.58 lakh Cr, with no NIM guidance and ECL impact deferred to end of Q3.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹5,611.81 Cr (+24.4% YoY), net profit ₹857.69 Cr (+52.9% YoY).
AU SFB reported Q2FY27 PAT up 53% YoY to ₹858 Cr with deposits rising 29% YoY to ₹1.70 lakh Cr and credit cost improving to 0.8%.
Audio recording of conference call with analysts and investors held on October 24, 2026 made available on the Bank’s website.
AU Small Finance Bank reported Q2FY27 earnings call transcripts highlighting 29% YoY deposit growth and stable asset quality.

watchlist.response: Prince and Gaurav said credit cards and PL are newer, still coming up the curve, and credit card is loss-making; asked for time before discussing product ROA or risk-adjusted yields.
watchlist.text: Risk-adjusted yields in digital unsecured look lower than retail secured given higher GNPA and LGDs; product profitability not shared.

watchlist.response: Vivek said it is premature to quantify, expects a neutral impact given low LGDs, and will give colour by end of Q3.
watchlist.text: ECL transition impact on steady-state credit cost, with other banks guiding 12–20 bps.

watchlist.response: Gaurav declined directional guidance, saying margins have multiple moving parts; cost of funds has bottomed and may rise slightly.
watchlist.text: NIM trajectory for the next two to three quarters.

watchlist.response: Prince said it will be part of the overall NPA; Gaurav noted CGFMU coverage on the GNPA portfolio is slightly lower as some NPAs come from pre-coverage vintages.
